newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly firmer on Friday, traders said.
Gasoline was $1-2 a tonne firmer supported by refinery shut-downs and recent arbitrage trade to the United States.
Spot gas oil prices were mixed with barges trading slightly lower while firm cargo premiums held outright prices steady in line with benchmark gas oil futures.
High sulphur fuel oil was steady to firmer. Barges traded up to $1 over Thursday's highest deal at $86.50, on good demand from players covering short positions and few sellers seen.
Cargoes were offered steady, particularly for straight-run that continues to be tight with continued demand, especially from refiners.
